title: Installation event
description: A new installation identifier, recorded when the CLI creates one: on the first recorded command, and again after telemetry is disabled and enabled.

id.description: A random identifier for this event, so that one sent twice is stored once.

occurredAt.description: When the identifier was created, in UTC, by this machine's clock.

installId.description: The new identifier, which the installation's command events carry from then on.
